<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><b>EXPLANATORY NOTE</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">On January&#160;30, 2026,
NRG Energy,&#160;Inc., a Delaware corporation (the &#8220;Company&#8221;), filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission a Current
Report on Form&#160;8-K (the &#8220;Original Report&#8221;) with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. The Original Report disclosed
the consummation of the previously announced transactions contemplated by the Purchase and Sale Agreement, dated May&#160;12, 2025 (the
 &#8220;Purchase Agreement&#8221;), by and among the Company, NRG East Generation Holdings LLC, a Delaware limited liability company and
direct, wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company (&#8220;Lightning Buyer&#8221;), NRG Texas LLC, a Delaware limited liability company and
direct, wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company (&#8220;Linebacker Buyer&#8221;), NRG Demand Response Holdings LLC, a Delaware limited
liability company and direct, wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company (&#8220;CCS Buyer&#8221;), NRG Gas Development Company, LLC, a Delaware
limited liability company and direct, wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company (&#8220;JCPD Buyer&#8221; and, collectively with Lightning
Buyer, Linebacker Buyer and CCS Buyer, the &#8220;Buyer Entities&#8221;), Lightning Power Holdings, LLC, a Delaware limited liability
company, Thunder Generation, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, CCS Power Holdings, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company,
and Linebacker Power Development Funding, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company. As a result of the transactions contemplated by
the Purchase Agreement, the Buyer Entities acquired all of the issued and outstanding equity interests of Lightning Power, LLC, a Delaware
limited liability company (&#8220;Lightning&#8221;), Linebacker Power Holdings, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (&#8220;Linebacker&#8221;),
CCS Intermediate HoldCo, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (&#8220;CCS&#8221;), and Jack County Power Development, LLC, a Delaware
limited liability company (&#8220;JCPD&#8221; and, collectively with Lightning, Linebacker and CCS and their respective subsidiaries,
the &#8220;Acquired Companies&#8221;). The acquisition of the equity interests, together with the other transactions contemplated by
the Purchase Agreement, are referred to herein as the &#8220;Transaction.&#8221; The Transaction was consummated on January&#160;30,
2026.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">On February&#160;2, 2026,
the Company amended the Original Report to include the financial statements required to be filed under Item 9.01(a)&#160;of Form&#160;8-K
and the pro forma financial information required to be filed in connection with the Transaction under Item 9.01(b)&#160;of Form&#160;8-K
(the &#8220;Form&#160;8-K/A&#8221;).</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 0"/><td style="width: 1in"><span style="font-size: 10pt"><b>Item 8.01</b></span></td><td style="text-align: justify"><b>Other
                                            Events</b></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">This Current Report on Form&#160;8-K
is being filed to provide the following information related to the Company&#8217;s acquisition of the Acquired Companies: (i)&#160;(x)&#160;Lightning
Power, LLC and its subsidiaries&#8217; audited consolidated financial statements as of December&#160;31, 2025 and for the year ended
December&#160;31, 2025 and for the period August&#160;9, 2024 to December&#160;31, 2024, (y)&#160;Fund III Projects&#8217; audited combined
financial statements for the period January&#160;1, 2024 to August&#160;8, 2024 and (z)&#160;Gridiron Intermediate Holdings, LLC and
its subsidiaries&#8217; audited consolidated financial statements for the period January&#160;1, 2024 to August&#160;8, 2024 (the &#8220;Lightning
Financial Statements&#8221;), (ii)&#160;Linebacker Power Funding, LLC and its subsidiaries&#8217; audited consolidated financial statements
as of December&#160;31, 2025 and for the years ended December&#160;31, 2025 and 2024 (the &#8220;Linebacker Financial Statements&#8221;),
(iii)&#160;CCS Power Finance Co, LLC and its subsidiaries&#8217; audited consolidated financial statements as of December&#160;31, 2025
and for the years ended December&#160;31, 2025 and 2024 (the &#8220;CCS Financial Statements&#8221; and, collectively with the Lightning
Financial Statements and the Linebacker Financial Statements, the &#8220;Audited Financial Statements&#8221;) and (iv)&#160;the Company&#8217;s
unaudited pro forma combined financial information as of and for the year ended December&#160;31, 2025, after giving effect to the Transaction
(the &#8220;Pro Forma Financial Information&#8221; and, together with the Audited Financial Statements, the &#8220;Financial Information&#8221;).</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The Financial Information
updates and supplements the audited consolidated financial statements of the Acquired Companies and unaudited pro forma combined financial
information of the Company and related disclosures contained in Exhibits 99.1, 99.5, 99.7 and 99.9 to the Form&#160;8-K/A. To the extent
that information in this Current Report on Form&#160;8-K differs from or updates information contained in the Form&#160;8-K/A, the information
in this Current Report on Form&#160;8-K shall supersede or supplement the information in the Form&#160;8-K/A.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></p>

the actual results or project future operating results of the Company following the Transaction.</p>
